theme: Dark Mode Only - High-End Financial Command Center (Luxury/Swiss)

typography.rules: Import fonts via: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@400;500;600&family=Outfit:wght@600;700;800&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap'); Never use Inter. Use uppercase with wide tracking for small labels.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use heavily on the right-side chat panel ('Cerebro') and sticky headers. Tailwind: bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-2xl border-l border-white/10.
visual_enhancers.grid_borders: Agent grid should look like a technical skeleton. Use subtle border-border classes to define areas without relying on heavy cards.
visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Active agent dots and the Cerebro voice button should have an electric cyan or pink glow (drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(0,255,255,0.5)]).

grids_and_layouts.strategy: Command Center / High Density Grid. It should feel like a Bloomberg terminal meets a futuristic spaceship dashboard.
grids_and_layouts.container: h-screen w-screen overflow-hidden flex bg-background text-foreground
grids_and_layouts.sidebar: w-64 border-r border-border p-4 flex flex-col hidden lg:flex
grids_and_layouts.main_content: flex-1 flex flex-col h-full overflow-y-auto px-4 md:px-8 py-6
grids_and_layouts.right_panel: w-full lg:w-96 border-l border-border bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl h-full flex flex-col

component_instructions.cards: Agent cards must be sleek. Subtle 1px border. Hover effect: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and the border illuminates slightly with the primary color.
component_instructions.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp (rounded-none). Never soft-rounded. Primary buttons should have a subtle inner glow.
component_instructions.inputs: Shadcn components heavily modified for dark mode. No white backgrounds. Focus ring is cyan.
component_instructions.chat_interface: Cerebro chat should feel conversational but technical. System messages in monospace.
component_instructions.activity_feed: A ticker or scrolling list showing real-time agent tasks (e.g., 'Agente 4: Clonando tienda X...', 'Agente 5: Beneficio +$400').

motion.entrance: Staggered fade-in for agent cards on mount.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against dark backgrounds passes WCAG AA. Muted text must not be darker than hsl(240, 5%, 50%).
accessibility.focus: Always use focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-background.
accessibility.data_testids: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='agent-card-1', data-testid='cerebro-voice-btn').

dashboard_background.description: Abstract geometric 3D luxury background. Use as a very subtle fixed background overlay with opacity-10.

cerebro_avatar.description: Futuristic glowing core node. Use as the avatar or visual representation for the Master 'Cerebro' agent.

media.icons: Use lucide-react. Match specific icons to the 10 agents (e.g., Package, Settings, TrendingUp, Copy, DollarSign, Share2, Video, Sparkles, Target, Brain).

general_ui_ux_guidelines: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
NEVER use emojis for icons. Use lucide-react instead.
Do not use transparent backgrounds for surfaces with content under them.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a Spanish-language command center dashboard for an autonomous Shopify AI empire.
The UI is a 3-column layout (or 2-column + sidebar): Left Sidebar (Nav), Center (KPIs + 10 Agent Cards + Real-time feed), Right Panel (Cerebro Chat/Voice).
Implement the 10 specific agents: 1. Productos, 2. Automatización, 3. Capital, 4. Clonación, 5. Finanzas, 6. RRSS, 7. Edición A/V, 8. Estética, 9. Ventas, 10. Cerebro.
The right panel 'Cerebro' is the master agent. It must feature a chat UI and a prominent, glowing voice input button.
Agent cards should open a detailed view or dialog when clicked, showing their specific conversation/logs.
Include a simulated metrics section at the top (e.g., Ingresos: $1.2M, Tiendas: 14, Tareas Activas: 42).
Include a real-time activity feed (e.g., a scrolling list of recent agent actions).
Apply the font configuration via index.css.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Ensure strictly adhering to the luxury dark mode theme, maintaining UI hierarchy, replacing emojis with lucide icons, adding micro-interactions, utilizing data-testid everywhere, and focusing on a high-density futuristic command-center aesthetic.
